sub_topics.name: Understanding Virtual Machines
sub_topics.description: so before understanding the world of containers it is very important to understand the world of virtual machines because if you consider virtual machines as advancement to physical servers then containers is an advancement to virtual machines

sub_topics.name: Limitations of Virtual Machines
sub_topics.description: so what happens is as a DevOps engineer you might have created many EC2 instances you might be playing with Jenkins you might be even the viewers of our channel all this 22 days we have created a lot of examples and everything we tried on EC2 instance

sub_topics.name: Introduction to Containers
sub_topics.description: so containers will solve the same problem that is they will effectively use your virtual machines to even reduce this problem so the problem with physical servers was solved to some extent using virtual machines now to the problem of virtual machines is also solved to some extent with containers

sub_topics.name: Advantages of Containers
sub_topics.description: why i said to some extent because containers still have some drawbacks you can use some advanced security policies or you know you can do some more things but even today virtual machines are very very secure when compared to containers

sub_topics.name: Docker introduction
sub_topics.description: so containers can be created in two ways one is you can create containers on top of virtual machines and the other is you can create containers on top of physical servers as well
